Evidence paths are relative to the repo root. title: Statement import and analytics refresh subtitle: Ledger rows and the import log commit as one unit; the analytics refresh runs after it and can be retried kind: flowchart direction: down layout: { spacing: compact } groups: lane-browser: type: lane label: Browser (SPA) evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useUploadSync.ts:83-214 lane-api: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useUploadSync.ts:160 parse: shape: process label: Parse, map, validate note: lazy SheetJS in: lane-browser evidence: frontend/src/lib/fileParser.ts:283-320 hash: shape: process label: SHA-256 file hash in: lane-browser evidence: [frontend/src/lib/fileParser.ts:54-55, frontend/src/lib/fileParser.ts:331] review: shape: manual label: Review snapshot note: "accounts, dates, counts; confirm full ledger" in: lane-browser evidence: - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/components/UploadReview.tsx:17 - frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/components/UploadReview.tsx:141 cancelled: shape: terminator label: Import cancelled in: lane-browser evidence: frontend/src/pages/upload-sync/useUploadSync.ts:199-203#handleCancelReview post: shape: data label: POST /api/upload note: "1-100,000 rows" in: lane-browser evidence: [frontend/src/services/api/upload.ts:52, frontend/src/hooks/api/useUpload.ts:22] size: shape: decision label: Body within limit? in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:97-136 rej-size: shape: terminator label: "413, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/main.py:130-136 accepted: shape: decision label: Request accepted? note: "JWT, schema, rate limit" in: lane-api # schema bounds at schemas/upload.py:66-83; CurrentUser and slowapi limit at api/upload.py:50-56 evidence: [backend/src/ledger_sync/schemas/upload.py:66-83, backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:50-56] rej-request: shape: terminator label: "401, 422 or 429, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: [backend/src/ledger_sync/schemas/upload.py:66-83, backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:50-56] normalize: shape: process label: Normalize every row in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:293-309 rows-ok: shape: decision label: All rows valid? in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:302-307 rej-rows: shape: terminator label: "400, ledger unchanged" in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:86-91 dup: shape: decision label: Already imported? note: user lock held in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:111-124 fingerprint: shape: process label: Capture source fingerprints in: lane-api evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:217-223#capture_source_identities rules: shape: process label: Apply rules and Review Queue fixes note: re-validated in: lane-api # a Review Queue fix wins over the rules and the source on every import (sync_engine.py:229-230); the # reconciler puts it back on rows it pairs by shape (sync_engine.py:189-190) evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:224-232 - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:229-230#apply_to_import_rows reconcile: shape: process label: Reconcile transactions, transfers in: lane-api evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:171-188 - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:189-190#restore_overwritten_fixes rej-reconcile: shape: terminator label: "400, [backend/src/ledger_sync/core/sync_engine.py:208-210, backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:86-91] commit: shape: database label: Commit ledger + import log note: one unit in: lane-api evidence: svg.title: Statement import and analytics refresh
svg.desc: Statement import and analytics refresh. 25 components in 2 groups. Connections: Choose statement file to Parse, map, validate; Parse, map, validate to SHA-256 file hash; SHA-256 file hash to Review snapshot; Review snapshot to POST /api/upload (confirm); Review snapshot to Import cancelled (cancel); POST /api/upload to Body within limit?; Body within limit? to 413, ledger unchanged (no); Body within limit? to Request accepted? (yes); Request accepted? to 401, 422 or 429, ledger unchanged (no); Request accepted? to Normalize every row (yes); Normalize every row to All rows valid?; All rows valid? to 400, ledger unchanged (no); All rows valid? to Already imported? (yes); Already imported? to Choose Sync changes (yes, not forced (409)); Already imported? to Capture source fingerprints (no, or force); Choose Sync changes to Review snapshot (force); Capture source fingerprints to Apply rules and Review Queue fixes; Apply rules and Review Queue fixes to Reconcile transactions, transfers; Reconcile transactions, transfers to Commit ledger + import log (soft-delete missing); Reconcile transactions, transfers to 400, rolled back (invalid or ambiguous); Commit ledger + import log to Refresh analytics; Refresh analytics to Refresh succeeded?; Refresh succeeded? to Saved, insights ready (yes); Refresh succeeded? to Saved, insights failed (no: rollback refresh); and more.

text.tspan: Ledger rows and the import log commit as one unit; the analytics refresh runs after it and can be retried
